title: Change the homepage visual direction
context: The owner supplied a reference, reviewed the initial adaptation and requested a substantially more distinctive composition.
options: Continue the original Annotated visual direction
choice: Use an oversized two-line mono poster, offset blue surname frame, a native project index and a varied editorial spread with original project illustrations.
tradeoff: The larger identity uses more vertical space; compact facts and brief access remain above the fold. Labeled illustrations establish project identity while approved application captures remain unavailable.
